note: Retained Q125445 way/24824550 is the whole Temple of Heaven park boundary. It is preserved as evidence, never extruded. Current standard PMTiles identifies Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests as building/POI35184416009971 (OSM way43921139), with a19-vertex circular footprint and height38m. This staged source is anchored at that footprint center with +X east,+Z south. The broader site has140 provisional building-layer records, including overlapping parts and possible courtyard/container boundaries; they are retained for deliberate component review, not blindly extruded.

integrationReview.limitations: Approximate site fit from retained standard viewer PMTiles and DEM plus ordinary exterior pictures. Native+X is east,+Z south;fixed heading0 and the main hall footprint center define the pose. NativeY0 is the original DEM sample at that anchor,not a surveyed floor. Thirteen separately covered ground pockets preserve the park between groups. The building-only mask preserves independent mapped buildings,including attached shared edges. Host terrain data must resolve the same reference coordinate;architectural floor grades,gate forms,wall routes and exact facing remain visualization estimates. Physical laptop/phone and full-city benchmarks remain pending.
